tara: Blocking on docs PR #612 — I added an SDK example using `routeOptions` (camelCase) but runtime APIs use snake_case. Preview looks fine but we should be explicit about the mapping and preferred canonical names.
mike: can you paste the snippet?
tara: snippet: ```js const res = client.generate('hi', { route: 'alpha', routeOptions: { externalFallbacks: true } }) ```
alyssa: hold merge. The SDK currently maps `routeOptions.externalFallbacks` to `request.route_options.external_fallbacks` server-side, but our docs must call out the mapping and note that server fields are authoritative in API logs.
runtime-bot: confirmed: canonical server fields: `request.route_options.external_fallbacks` (bool). SDK convenience names vary by language. Precedence: deployment.routing_policy.allow_external_fallbacks -> request.route_options.external_fallbacks.
tara: suggestion for docs text: "SDK convenience flags may use camelCase; the server-side canonical field names are snake_case (e.g., request.route_options.external_fallbacks). Requests are evaluated against deployment routing_policy first"
mike: also add a tiny note on logging: admin logs will show snake_case names; helpful when debugging.
preview-bot: docs preview for PR #612 available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/612 (status: success)
tara: added mapping note and log-debug tip, pushed. PTAL.
alyssa: LGTM from docs side, runtime acked. Merging in the small-window. Thanks.
